title: Bug Report: Inconsistent Arrows in Widget and Notification
symptom: The trend arrows in the Widget and the Notification are inconsistent. It is dependent on the arrow direction. 45 degree up and down is different than all the other arrows. The 'Number Wall on Lock Screen' is also affected.
cause: Some of the default text arrows are not present in default Samsung font set, causing xDrip to replace missing symbols with their graphical equivalent.
fix: Change the phone's system font. On Samsung phone, changing font from Default to SamsungOne fixes the issue in all places including widget.
evidence_quote: THE SOLUTION is to change the phone's system font. For instance, on Samsung phone, changing font from Default to SamsungOne fix the issue (in all places including widget).
